purpose: Test whether a privileged MC estimate of gradient-error magnitude makes the existing symmetric pathwise robust set useful; separately decompose Q-gradient errors into magnitude and direction components.
oracle_radius_estimator: epsilon_i = norm(g_MC_current_policy_i - g_learned_i), where each MC gradient uses 8192 IID simulator continuations; the robust solver receives only epsilon_i, never the error direction.
direction_audit_source: pre-existing held-out current-policy MC gradient audits from the same obstacle task; use only reference gradients whose norm exceeds max(0.03, 3 times the vector MC standard error).
shared_across_lean_and_oracle_radius: offline dataset, Base, initial Critic and target Critic
Actor initialization, optimizer, TD and Actor update counts
minibatch/Flow RNG stream and fixed evaluation noise banks
claims_boundary: Privileged exploratory diagnostic, not deployable; epsilon is a finite-MC point estimate rather than a certified upper bound. Direction/magnitude decomposition is read-only and cannot establish policy-level causal effects.
